$comment: Declared non-REACHABLE states for published apt.*/rec.* operations. REACHABLE is never declared here: it is DERIVED by apps/web/tests/p1-28-qa.test.ts, which mocks the transport, runs every real adapter body and reads back the path actually requested. This file records only what that derivation cannot justify on its own, and scripts/ci/check-p1-28-adapter-reachability.mjs refuses any entry that does not satisfy every condition in its docblock. Adding an entry here is not a way to make a red gate green; it is a way to owe something in public.

rec.receiving-employee-list.ownerDecision: The receiving employee is a SELECTED ACTIVE IAM USER who accepts custody, not free text.
rec.receiving-employee-list.reason: DBCR-P1-18-002 publishes GET /reception-catalogue/receiving-employees so the check-in wizard can offer branch-eligible active IAM users instead of the tenant-wide iam.user.read staff directory it reads today (P1-28-SEC-001, debt G-EMP / R6). The Backend half is complete and mirrored; the production adapter and the picker that consumes it are handwritten Frontend, which the p1-18-read-surface ownership profile forbids on this branch. Widening that profile would let Frontend ride inside a Backend remediation reviewed by nobody, so the transition is named instead. This entry is deleted by the same change that adds the adapter and its consumer on feature/p1-28-owner-decisions-frontend, at which point QA-001 derives REACHABLE; until then P1-28-FE-007 stays PARTIAL and no 35/35 claim is possible, because writing PASS into task-matrix-verdicts.json while this entry stands is refused by condition 5.
rec.receiving-employee-list.introducedAgainstBaseNote: PINNED to an immutable commit, not a moving ref. It was origin/develop, which was true on the pull request and FALSE the moment the merge landed: develop then contained the operation, so the gate correctly refused its own entry on protected develop. A base that moves cannot support a claim about what a branch INTRODUCED. 592cfe6e is the develop this work was reviewed against (P1-15 merge), and the operation was absent there permanently.

The refusal workflow screen is what offers it, and that screen is handwritten Frontend. It is published and mirrored by this Backend remediation, which runs under p1-18-read-surface and is forbidden to write the adapter its mirror row then obliges.
